# StatsLab EdTech R&D Ecosystem (GitHub Repository LLM Directive)

> **StatsLab DSI** is an Islamic-based Open Source EdTech R&D ecosystem in Indonesia, developed by **Muhammad Khoiruzzadittaqwa (muhzadit)** from **Tadris Matematika, Institut Al-Bahjah Cirebon**.
> **Repository:** https://github.com/zaditprodakwah/statslab  
> **Production Web Application:** https://dstatistika.pages.dev/  
> **Open Science Empirical Dataset (Kaggle DOI):** https://doi.org/10.34740/kaggle/dsv/22047486 (Kaggle: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/muhzadit/statslab-dsi-empirical-data)

## Core Metadata & Empirical Validation
- **Project Name:** StatsLab DSI (Interactive Statistics Dashboard & EdTech R&D Ecosystem)
- **R&D Framework:** 4D Model (Define, Design, Develop, Disseminate) by Thiagarajan, Semmel, and Semmel (1974).
- **Curriculum Alignment:** Kurikulum Merdeka SMP Fase D (SK BSKAP No. 033/H/KR/2022 hal. 147 & No. 032/H/KR/2024 hal. 132).
- **Content Validity:** 6 university expert judges, 33 instrument items, Aiken's V = 0.85 (p < 0.05, Highly Valid).
- **Field Usability:** 4 multidisciplinary educators (83.1%) and 31 Grade VII students, System Usability Scale (SUS) = 68.0 (Good Usability / Marginal High).
- **Qualitative Integrity:** CAQDAS REFI-QDA XML standard codebook (Krippendorff's Alpha = 0.9476).
- **Islamic Ethical Values:** Amanah (Honest Y-axis / Anti-Truncation), Tabayyun (Spike & Outlier Verification), and Tawazun (Proportional Mean-Median Balance).

## Monorepo Architecture
- `apps/statslab-dsi`: Production React 19, TypeScript 5.7, Vite 6.2, Hono 4.7 edge functions, deployed on Cloudflare Pages (`dstatistika.pages.dev`).
- `apps/web`: Next.js 15 App Router, React 19, TypeScript 5, Prisma v7, Neon PostgreSQL, Recharts, Zustand.
- `packages/analysis`: R psychometric scripts (`rasch-pcm.r`, `cfa-lavaan.r`) for Rasch Partial Credit Model & Confirmatory Factor Analysis.
- `packages/datasets/empirical`: Open-access empirical datasets, SPSS binary `.sav` and syntax `.sps`, live CSVs, JSON, and REFI-QDA XML codebooks.
- `packages/rubrics`: Analytic rubric definitions for polytomous scoring (0, 1, 2) and System Usability Scale (SUS 14).
